svg.aria-label: The sentence Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot, cut three ways. Letters: 52 tokens, one per character, from 91 token cards. My 8k BPE: 13 tokens, mostly whole words, with IDs 271 282 97 240 and so on. GPT-2: the same 13 pieces, with IDs 7454 2402 257 640 and so on, from 50,257 token cards.
svg.text: The tokeniser cuts text into tokens, and each token's ID picks its own token card
Real cuts and IDs. A · marks a space that belongs to a token.
Fewer tokens per sentence lets the same row of positions hold more text. More pieces means more token cards to store and train.
